hadith.text: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ

hadith.expanded_reference: Jāmiʿ at-Tirmidhī, Kitāb az-Zuhd (Book 36: Asceticism), Bāb 11, Hadith 2317
hadith.text: اسلام کا حسن کیا ہے، خوبصورتی کیا ہے؟ کہ ان باتوں کو چھوڑ دے جس سے اس کا کوئی مطلب نہیں۔

hadith.expanded_reference: Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Jihād was-Siyar (Book 56: Fighting for the Cause of Allah), Bāb 102, Hadith 2942
hadith.text: اور ایک شخص آپ کو دیکھ کے مسلمان ہو گیا نا، تو وہ آپ کے لیے سرخ قیمتی اونٹوں سے زیادہ بہتر ہے، دنیا کی بڑی بڑی نعمتوں سے زیادہ بہتر ہے۔

dua.text: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

topics.name: Self-Accountability (Muhasabah)
topics.description: Evaluating one's own actions, recognizing personal flaws, and taking responsibility for self-improvement.

topics.name: Intellect ('Aql)
topics.description: Intellect as a divine trust and test, the faculty distinguishing humans from animals, and purposeful living.

topics.name: Calling to Good (Da'wah)
topics.description: Guiding others towards virtue, sharing beneficial reminders, and earning reward equal to the doer.

topics.name: The Hereafter (Akhirah)
topics.description: Contrasting temporary worldly assistance with everlasting salvation in the Akhirah.

topics.name: Internalization of Knowledge ('Ilm wa 'Amal)
topics.description: The necessity of digesting and practicing knowledge rather than merely accumulating passive information.

topics.name: Minding One's Affairs (Tark Ma La Ya'nih)
topics.description: Excellence in faith demonstrated by self-restraint and avoiding unnecessary interference in what does not concern one.

topics.name: Prayer and Discipline (Salah)
topics.description: Straightening and aligning rows in prayer as an integral element of worship and communal order.

topics.name: Moral Example and Accountability (Qudwah)
topics.description: Living as an embodiment of Islamic values before society while maintaining consciousness of divine watch.
